titlePlaceholder: For example: Biology, chapter 4: cell structure
dragInstructions: Press space to pick up a card, use the arrow keys to move it, and space again to drop it. Press escape to cancel.
importBody: Paste from a spreadsheet, a document or notes. Each card needs a term and a definition.
importFile: Choose a CSV or text file
importPreviewEmpty: Nothing to import yet. Paste some cards above.
importMore: {count, plural, one {…and # more card} other {…and # more cards}}
importIncomplete: {count, plural, one {# card is missing a term or definition. You can fill it in after importing.} other {# cards are missing a term or definition. You can fill them in after importing.}}
importTruncated: A set can hold up to {max} cards. The rest were left out.
imported: {count, plural, one {# card imported} other {# cards imported}}
importFileError: That file couldn't be read as text.
mediaPremium: Images and audio on cards are part of Premium.
errorNoCards: Add at least one card with a term or a definition.
errorTooLong: Card {number} is too long. Keep each side under {max} characters.
incompleteNote: {count, plural, one {# card is missing a term or definition and will be skipped while studying.} other {# cards are missing a term or definition and will be skipped while studying.}}
unsavedBody: Your changes haven't been saved. They're kept as a draft on this device, so you can pick up where you left off.
staleBody: It was edited in another tab or on another device after you opened it here. Saving now will replace that version with this one.
offlineSave: You're offline. Your draft is saved on this device; connect to save it to your account.
publicNeedsVerify: Confirm your email address before making a set public.
tips: Tip: press Tab to move to the next field. Tab from the last card adds a new one.
